outcome: ratio of time to peak tidal expiratory flow (tPTEF) to expiratory time (tE)
cohort: 91 healthy 3-month-old infants from the Scandinavian Preventing Atopic Dermatitis and ALLergies in children (PreventADALL) birth cohort
finding: TFV loop parameters differed significantly between awake and sleeping states in 3-month-old infants, with higher tPTEF/tE, VPTEF/VE, and respiratory rate while awake but similar VT, suggesting a need for arousal state-specific normative values.
